name: @juansync7/design-tokens
description: Read design tokens from CSS, export them as W3C Design Tokens (DTCG 2025.10) with light and dark themes, and check every colour pair against WCAG 2.2 in both
author: Juan Kok (https://juansync.dev)

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js && esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --banner:js='#!/usr/bin/env node' --outfile=dist/cli.js && tsc -p .
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run check
